_doc: Glyph map of this language: every glyph id of the font with its character, PNG file and engine width, plus the font tables (CPU address, SHA-256 of the built bytes). tools/translate/font.py build turns this map and the PNGs into sFontGlyphs_*.bin; the text tools read the characters from here. Format: docs/formats/font.md

glyphs.note: next-screen marker; the control word $00A2 is written <NEXT> in the text
